preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the LiquidityGeneratorToken to initiate the transfer
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to trigger swapAndLiquify (balanceOf(address(this)) >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract that implements a reentrancy attack in its fallback/receive function. Call transfer() to the malicious contract with an amount that doesn't trigger swapAndLiquify initially. The malicious contract should have a fallback function that repeatedly calls transfer() again before the state updates in _transferStandard/_transferToExcluded/_transferFromExcluded are completed. This can potentially bypass fee deductions or cause double-spending by re-entering during the token balance update process.
